title: Avalon AI
tagline: Avalon AI is a groundbreaking app on the Mode Testnet, combining AI, creativity, and blockchain. It enables users to trade AI-generated prompts as NFTs, bridging AI and blockchain innovation for a unique creative experience.
description:
With the current growth of generative AI art platforms like Stable Diffusion and Midjourney, there is a need for a decentralized platform where creators can monetize their generative AI prompts and earn royalty

AI-Powered Creativity Unleashed:
Avalon AI is an avant-garde creation tool that lets users generate captivating images through the prowess of artificial intelligence. Whether you're an artist seeking inspiration or an enthusiast exploring new horizons, Avalon AI opens the door to a universe of possibilities. With its integrated generative art ai models, the app generates stunning visuals that challenge the conventional boundaries of human creativity.

Tokenizing Creativity with NFTs:
What sets Avalon AI apart is its integration with the Mode Testnet's blockchain technology. The app empowers users to not only create mesmerizing images but also tokenizes the very prompts used to generate those images, alongside the images themselves. Each image and its corresponding prompt become unique, indivisible tokens known as NFTs. This process brings a new dimension to the art world, where digital assets can be owned, traded, and cherished in a manner never seen before.

Monetization and Royalties for AI Creators:
Avalon AI goes beyond being just a creative outlet; it's a groundbreaking marketplace where AI art creators can monetize their ingenuity. Artists have the ability to set prices for their NFTs, attaching value to their creations. Additionally, the built-in royalty system ensures that creators continue to earn a share whenever their NFTs are resold within the Avalon AI ecosystem. This introduces a sustainable stream of income for artists and motivates them to continue honing their craft.

When users buy an NFT Prompt on Avalon, they can also generate a secondary Image called Derivatives and also list on the marketplace. The original creator also earns royalty on each secondary sale
how_its_made:
The project is built on Stable Diffusion and the Mode Testnet

For this version, we use the Stable Diffusion "stable-diffusion-xl-beta-v2-2-2" release for generating images based on User prompts.

We created an ERC1155 smart contract and marketplace that allows "Prompt Engineers" and AI creators to tokenize their NFTprompts. 

Creators can set a max supply, a price and list their NFT prompt on the marketplace.

The NFT prompts are tokengated using the Sepolia mode blockscout RPC API, and the contracts are deployed on the Mode Testnet
